content.text:
server.servlet.context-path=/xplan-manager-api
springdoc.api-docs.enabled=true
springdoc.enable-default-api-docs=false
springdoc.swagger-ui.enabled=true
springdoc.swagger-ui.path=/
springdoc.swagger-ui.urls[0].url=/api/v2
springdoc.swagger-ui.urls[0].name=Manager API V2
springdoc.swagger-ui.urls[1].url=/xmanager/api/v1/
springdoc.swagger-ui.urls[1].name=Manager API V1 (deprecated)
springdoc.swagger-ui.urlsPrimaryName=Manager API V2

observation.command:
cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import zipfile
z=zipfile.ZipFile('/opt/tomcat-api/webapps/xplan-manager-api.war')
print(z.read('WEB-INF/classes/application.properties').decode('latin-1'))
" 2>&1 | grep -iE "api-docs|swagger|springdoc|context|server" | head
